paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different processing layers under varying conditions. The x-axis represents different groupings of layers: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" with a linear scale, ranging from -15% to 5% with tick intervals at every 5%. The plot includes four lines. A yellow line with circular markers and a solid style represents "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit", starting near 0% at Layer1-4 and maintaining a consistent trend across all layers. A red line with square markers and a solid style represents "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit", starting at 0%, dipping slightly, and then returning close to 0% by Layer29-32. A light blue line with circular markers and a solid style represents "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit", starting around 0% at Layer1-4, moving to around 5% at Layer13-20, and returning just below 0% by Layer29-32. A dark blue line with square markers and a solid style represents "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit", starting near -2% at Layer1-4, dropping to a low point near -15% at Layer13-20, and increasing to around -2% at Layer29-32. A dashed grey line represents the "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit", consistently positioned at 0% across all layers. A legend is placed at the top center representing different layer and its corresponding colors.
